replies.text: Any idea why my standing desk keeps drifting down?
replies.reply: Common causes for a standing desk drifting down: (1) a failing or slipping gas strut in single-column desks, (2) a lift motor or control box issue letting the motors back-drive, (3) the desk exceeding its weight capacity, or (4) a cheap/loose cam or crossbar hardware sagging. Try emptying the desk and testing the memory presets — if it still sinks with no load, it's likely the motor/control box rather than the weight. If it's under warranty, the manufacturer can usually replace the lift column.
